retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, macro-detail split portrait showing two distinct personas of the same subject through lighting and expression.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring two extreme close-up halves of a face, one smiling with bright lighting and the other somber with moody shadows, separated by a narrow vertical gap containing centered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two contrasting facial expressions
Macro-level skin and hair texture against a clean neutral background
Centralized typographic anchor point between the two subjects
Lighting contrast between warm/bright and cool/shadowed tones
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping that cuts off the outer edges of the heads
Visible skin pores and fine hair detail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale partial faces flanking the left and right edges, meeting near the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central text block and the eyes of the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the smiling left eye to the intense right eye, then down to the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A thin vertical strip of light grey space in the center and the top corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated skin tones and neutral grey background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for teeth and typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast to emphasize texture over color.

letterConstructionRules: Inverted or mirrored characters to signify duality
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inverted 'E' or 'M' to create a mirrored effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with weight and orientation variations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, and geometric feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary squareness and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail macro photograph of two faces split down the middle. The left face is smiling with visible diamond-encrusted teeth and warm lighting. The right face is serious with dark dreadlocks and cool, shadowed lighting. Place them against a light grey studio background with a narrow gap between them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of wide, geometric sans-serif text in the center gap. Use white fill. Include a standard black and white parental advisory logo at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture sharp and visible?
Are the two faces clearly contrasting in mood?
Is the text centered in the negative space between the faces?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central negative space
postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'vs' or central connector is smaller than the main names
Ensure the background is a clean, neutral gradient
Confirm the hair texture is distinct and high-resolution
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Split Portrait + Geometric Extended Sans + High Contrast Duality Lighting
